# YogSaathi - Full Platform Guide & Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive information on YogSaathi's online yoga classes, certified trainers, therapy modules, schedule, pricing, and health philosophies.

## About YogSaathi

YogSaathi is a premier Indian online yoga and wellness institution dedicated to making authentic, high-quality yoga accessible to everyone at their doorstep. 

### Mission and Vision
Founded with the vision that yoga is not just physical exercise but a holistic pathway to mental clarity, physical vitality, and inner peace. YogSaathi brings traditional yogic wisdom together with modern convenience through live interactive classes streamed directly to mobile phones, tablets, laptops, and smart TVs.

### Leadership & Instructors (E-E-A-T)
- **Sanjay Kumar Mahesh (Founder & CEO)**: B.E. Mechanical Engineering graduate from IIT Roorkee with 38 years of corporate and leadership experience. Passionate about health transformation through daily yoga.
- **Ms. Upma Gupta (Senior Yoga Master)**: Certified Senior Yoga Master, Diploma in Naturopathy and Yoga, MA in Science of Living, Preksha Meditation & Yoga. Over 15 years of dedicated yoga teaching experience.
- **Monika Bhatnagar (Yoga & Naturopathy Expert)**: 4-Year Diploma in Naturopathy & Yogic Science (DNYS). Over 12 years of clinical and instructional yoga experience.
- **Aniket Saini (Ashtanga & Dynamic Flow Instructor)**: Master's in Yogic Science from Gurukul Kangri, Haridwar. Over 6 years experience including 6 months teaching yoga internationally in Vietnam.

## Daily Class Schedule & Slot Flexibility

YogSaathi offers unprecedented flexibility with 7 daily live slots every single day. Members are not locked into a single fixed time:
- Slot 1: 5:00 AM - 6:00 AM
- Slot 2: 6:00 AM - 7:00 AM
- Slot 3: 7:00 AM - 8:00 AM
- Slot 4: 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM
- Slot 5: 5:30 PM - 6:30 PM
- Slot 6: 6:30 PM - 7:30 PM
- Slot 7: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM

Members can freely switch slots on any day depending on their personal or professional commitments.

## Core Programs Offered

1. **Daily General Wellness Yoga**:
   - Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutations)
   - Asanas for joint mobility, spinal health, and flexibility
   - Pranayama: Kapalabhati, Anulom Vilom, Bhramari, Sheetali
   - Dhyana (Meditation) and Yoga Nidra

2. **YogaCare (Therapeutic & Personalized)**:
   - Chronic Back & Neck Pain Relief
   - Diabetes & Blood Sugar Control Support
   - Hypertension & Cardiovascular Health
   - Thyroid & Metabolic Health
   - Arthritis & Joint Care

3. **Ashtanga Yoga Series**:
   - Vinyasa system, Ujjayi pranayama, Bandhas (energy locks), and Drishti (gaze points)
   - Dynamic Sun Salutations A & B, standing poses, seated forward bends, and finishing postures

4. **Women's Holistic Yoga**:
   - PCOD / PCOS hormonal balance routines
   - Prenatal & Postnatal care
   - Pelvic floor strengthening and stress hormone reduction

5. **Kids Yoga**:
   - Fun, imaginative animal poses (Simhasana, Vrikshasana, Bhujangasana)
   - Postural alignment for growing bodies
   - Mindfulness and memory enhancement games

## Pricing & Value

YogSaathi offers some of the most competitive, cost-effective yoga subscription plans in India, starting at nominal monthly rates with multi-month subscription bonuses (e.g. 12 + 6 months free, 6 + 3 months free, 3 + 1 month free) and complimentary certified nutritionist consultations.
